What if you chewed loudly every day?
Chewing is one of the most normal sounds at any dinner table. You might not even notice it. Crunchy snacks and gum can be heard from across a room.

But here's the twist. For people with misophonia, chewing sounds can trigger real anger or panic, like a fight or flight alarm in the brain! Scientists found their brains react more strongly to these trigger sounds. Some people with misophonia even wear headphones at meals to cope.
